body.message: This is very unprofessional and I will be writing a review about you guys for this. This is an unethical practice you are running, once you view the apartment and the client is ready to close the deal you are backing out with random excuses. The building has so many residents, are you telling me they are living there without utility connections? It’s rubbish. You don’t even have the courage to tell the truth. Maybe you got a better deal so now you’re backing out with this reason.
